findings.title: The /business cluster is unknown to Google
findings.description: URL Inspection on 30.7.2026 returns 'URL is unknown to Google' for both /business (the hub) and /business/cafe. GSC reports indexed: 0 of 162 submitted. This is not a sitemap failure — the sitemap was read. It is a link-discovery failure: each /business/<slug> page has exactly one inbound internal link, from the hub, and the hub is not in the main navigation. Evidence that discovery works when present: /business/garage, /business/restaurant and /business/minimarket did accumulate 7, 8 and 2 impressions.
findings.recommendation: Request Indexing manually in GSC for the 5 top pages (user-only action), and add /business to the main navigation plus cross-links from /self-employed/opening-business and /self-employed/business-setup-cost.

findings.title: /tools/capital is an orphan page
findings.description: Zero inbound internal links and no <h1>. It is in the sitemap at app/sitemap.ts:143 and has accumulated 4 impressions at position 49.
findings.recommendation: Add an <h1> and link it from the /tools hub.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Median 904 words per page; deepest pages reach 3,743 words (/self-employed/opening-business) and 3,426 (/guides/mortgage-complete-guide-2026)
Named CPA author with AuthorBox on every calculator page and Person schema
Primary-source citations: 36 links to kolzchut.org.il, 34 to gov.il, 23 to btl.gov.il, 10 to boi.org.il

findings.title: Person sameAs is missing the CPA license number and LinkedIn
findings.description: Open since 1.7.2026. The LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/andreypl) already appears in llms.txt but not in the Person schema, which is where Google reads it. On a YMYL site, unverified professional identity caps trust.
findings.recommendation: Add both to Person.sameAs in components/seo/. Requires the license number from the user.

findings.title: All 63 glossary pages are noindexed
findings.description: Every /glossary/* term carries robots noindex,follow and is excluded from the sitemap. This is deliberate and well-reasoned (app/glossary/[slug]/page.tsx:24-28 — definitions under 60 words are thin content). But 0 of 63 clear the threshold, so an entire subtree yields no index value, and the /glossary hub sits at position 60.9 with 81 impressions.
findings.recommendation: Expand 10-15 high-demand terms past 60 words. The mechanism returns them to the index automatically.

findings.title: Ten hub pages are thin and rank poorly
findings.recommendation: Enrich each hub with an intro answer paragraph, a comparison table, and descriptive links to its children.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 226 of 226 canonicals correct — zero missing, zero mismatched
Zero missing titles, zero missing meta descriptions, zero duplicate H1s
Only one duplicate title pair, and it is a crawl artifact of the homepage with and without a trailing slash

findings.title: 134 of 226 titles exceed 60 characters; 57 exceed 65
findings.description: The longest reach 82 characters (/business/office, /business/clinic), losing roughly 20 characters to SERP truncation. The suffix ' | חשבונאי' costs 10 characters on every page. 36 meta descriptions also exceed 160 characters.
findings.recommendation: Drop the brand suffix on the long pages and trim to under 60 characters.

findings.title: Internal link equity is extremely skewed
findings.description: /privacy and /terms receive 226 inbound internal links each from the footer. All 21 /business pages, /employee-rights/salary-deductions, /real-estate/rental-income-tax, /investments/capital-gains-tax and /tools/customer-lifetime-value receive exactly one. /tools/capital receives zero.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual cross-links from the pillar pages and put /business into the main navigation.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Zero broken JSON-LD blocks and zero pages without schema across 226 pages
Organization and WebSite on 224 pages, BreadcrumbList on 147, FAQPage on 105, DefinedTerm on 62, SoftwareApplication on 50, BlogPosting on 43

findings.title: HowTo schema is used on only 3 pages
findings.description: The site is built around 'how do I calculate X' intent, which HowTo is designed for, but only 3 of 226 pages carry it.
findings.recommendation: Add HowTo to calculator pages that already contain a step-by-step worked example.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS is 0 on both desktop and mobile
TBT 0ms desktop, 80ms mobile
Lighthouse SEO 100 and Best Practices 100
Server response 60ms via Vercel edge prerendering

findings.title: Mobile LCP is 6.2 seconds against 1.2 seconds on desktop
findings.description: Lighthouse 12.8 mobile: performance 66, FCP 3.8s, LCP 6.2s, Speed Index 5.3s. The LCP element is a text paragraph, not an image, so this is a network and font blocking issue rather than an image issue. Israeli search traffic is predominantly mobile.
findings.recommendation: Add preconnect hints, consider lazyOnload for analytics, and review the three loaded font families (Heebo, JetBrains_Mono, Frank_Ruhl_Libre, 85KB combined).

findings.title: gtag.js is the heaviest asset on the site
findings.description: 167KB of a 748KB page (22%), of which 70KB is unused. Installed 26.7.2026 in app/layout.tsx:176 with strategy='afterInteractive'. Lighthouse measures 302ms wasted for lack of a preconnect to google-analytics.com.
findings.recommendation: Add preconnect to googletagmanager.com and google-analytics.com; evaluate strategy='lazyOnload'.

findings.title: Three accessibility failures on a site that publishes an accessibility statement
findings.description: Lighthouse accessibility 91. color-contrast fails on 17 elements (mostly text-ink/60 on cream), label fails on 3 number inputs in the work-grant calculator, heading-order fails on 2 elements. The site has an /accessibility page and statement.
findings.recommendation: Raise text-ink/60 to text-ink/75, associate labels with the inputs, and fix the h4-without-h3 sequence.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt and llms-full.txt present and well written, including explicit guidance on when an LLM should cite the site
robots.txt explicitly allows 11 AI crawlers
FAQPage on 105 pages, DefinedTerm on 62, Dataset on 6
Evidence of AI citation: /blog/vat-complete-guide-israel at 573 impressions position 7.7 and /blog/surtax-yesef-2026-explained at 216 impressions position 10.2, both on short knowledge queries

findings.title: The .answer-box pattern is on only 34 of 226 pages
findings.description: The quickAnswer slot in CalculatorLayout is the site's mechanism for featured snippets and AI Overview citation, and it is implemented on 15% of pages.
findings.recommendation: Add a quickAnswer paragraph to the 20 highest-impression pages first.

findings.title: Do not treat AI fan-out zero-CTR pages as CTR failures
findings.description: Query-level inspection confirms that the zero-click, high-impression blog pages rank on short knowledge queries that Google answers directly in an AI Overview. This is a citation signal.
findings.recommendation: Leave the titles on those pages alone.

categories.name: Images

findings.title: 102 pages have no og:image
findings.description: Includes the entire /business cluster and /about. Sharing these links on WhatsApp, Facebook or LinkedIn produces an empty preview, and it weakens presentation in AI surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Add a dynamic opengraph-image.tsx template to cover all of them at once.
